guidebook.intro: Afrika Mashariki ina mlima mrefu zaidi Afrika, ziwa lake kubwa zaidi na chanzo cha Nile. Haya ni maneno ya mazingira kwa Kiingereza.

phrases.target: Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.
phrases.base: Kilimanjaro ni mlima mrefu zaidi Afrika.

tips.title: “The” na majina
body: Mito na bahari huchukua **the**: **the Nile**, **the Indian Ocean**. Milima mingi na maziwa hayachukui: **Mount Kenya**, **Lake Victoria**, **Kilimanjaro**.
**The highest mountain** (mlima mrefu zaidi): **-est** na **the** kwa kilicho juu ya vyote.

tips.title: Let’s na must
body: **Tutunze** ni **Let’s look after**: **Let’s** (let us) + kitenzi ni “tu-…-e” ya Kiswahili. **Let’s plant trees!** (Tupande miti!)
**Lazima** ni **must**: **We must look after the environment.** Baada ya **must**, kitenzi cha msingi, bila **to**.

culture.title: Wangari Maathai
body: Wangari Maathai alisema: **“It’s the little things citizens do.”** Harakati yake ya **Green Belt Movement** ilipanda mamilioni ya miti, na alishinda **Nobel Peace Prize** mwaka 2004.

stories.title: Kilimanjaro
stories.summary: Juma anamwendesha Emma hadi Moshi, ambako Kilimanjaro inaonekana kupitia mawingu.

line.speaker: emma
line.base: Juma, angalia! Mlima ule ni nini?

line.speaker: juma
line.target: It’s Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa.
line.base: Ni Kilimanjaro, mlima mrefu zaidi Afrika.

line.speaker: juma
line.target: Yes, but every year there’s less. We must look after the environment.
line.base: Ndiyo, lakini kila mwaka kuna kidogo zaidi. Tunapaswa kutunza mazingira.
